final_answer.key_evidence_summary: productcatalogservice pod (productcatalogservice-747b447754-r49cw, worker-02) is the only outlier with RESTARTS 2 (30s ago) / Restart Count 3 and Ready False, while all other 10 boutique services show RESTARTS 0. Pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.192:3550/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x06\x04..."' (x9) followed by 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3), with Last State Terminated Reason Error Exit Code 2. Config cross-check (GetAppYAML) shows the liveness probe is httpGet on port 3550 while the readiness probe on the same port is grpc; container logs confirm the server is gRPC-only ('starting grpc server at :3550'). The httpGet probe therefore cannot decode the gRPC (HTTP/2) response, fails permanently, and kubelet kills/restarts the container in a loop. Port (3550), probe timing and the readiness probe are all correct, isolating the break to the liveness probe protocol.
